reusing_old_results: Do not attach old attempts to a newly frozen run. Changed DRM/model/NTO behavior invalidates reuse for dependent algorithms. Unchanged OMPL may be compared separately with a disclosed compatibility audit, but a new complete cohort is simpler and removes ambiguity.
source_freeze: Commit all runtime and config changes before prepare. prepare uses Git-recoverable exact source hashes; unfinished runs refuse changed source on resume.
invalid_input_policy: Keep all original registrations. Frozen invalid endpoints return before GPU/model creation. Summary legal denominator is 395 for test; 25 invalid rows are not dropped from evidence.

timing_policy.process_scope: Fresh process, imports, CUDA context, model/map load, warm-up, planning, validation and output
timing_policy.timeout: SIGTERM, then SIGKILL if needed; timed-out outputs never promoted to success
timing_policy.observed_previous_runtime_is_not_forecas: Prior 840 dev queries sum to about 1.16 hours; actual new runtime depends on fixes and failures. Worst-case legal query deadline sum is 136.03 hours before coordination overhead.

continuation_policy: resume keeps sealed terminal failures, successes and timeouts; only missing/interrupted retry_pending attempts are resumed. Interrupted attempts remain in raw evidence. Main statistics choose first terminal attempt, never best-of.
verification_caveat: verify integrity/complete does not mean all baseline jobs were healthy; inspect normalized infrastructure_error counts in status/export. Raw solver_failed can normalize to infrastructure_error when an exception occurred.
commands_after_runtime_commit: bash local/python.sh scripts/evaluate.py batch --split smoke --seeds 0 --track both --output results/repaired_smoke --prepare-only
bash local/python.sh scripts/evaluate.py batch --split dev --seeds 0 1 2 --track both --output results/repaired_dev_all_seeds --prepare-only
bash local/python.sh scripts/evaluate.py batch --split test --seeds 0 --track both --output results/repaired_test --prepare-only
bash local/python.sh scripts/evaluate.py summarize --selection results/selection.json --output results
selection_instructions: Append new comparison specifications to the existing selection file; do not overwrite old comparison groups. For conditional fixed_frontend, select the eight DRM-dependent methods and use mode=fixed_frontend; exact identical validated path hashes are checked. Fixed initial-region comparison needs a separate receipt-bound fixed_initial_regions run, not a post-hoc claim that equal seeds imply equal regions.

resolved_checker_test_failure.reason: Reference manifest argument shadowed by a canonical-case local variable during adding the pinned validation protocol comparison.
resolved_checker_test_failure.resolution: Renamed the local case variable; all expanded15 CPU tests now pass.
